integrity: Complete analytic proof with an accompanying independent symbolic-and-numeric checker; numerical samples are not an infinite proof. Provenance, source ownership and limitations are stated in the paper.
scientific_limitations: Mathematical peak count for a noise-free positive additive two-Debye susceptibility only; not a statistical or finite-bandwidth resolvability test; non-Debye, conductivity and oscillator contributions are excluded. General mixture-modality principles pre-exist and possible unseen hyperbolic-secant special cases pose priority risk.
title: A sharp loss-peak resolution wedge and cusp law for two Debye relaxations
